results.title: DigitalOcean raises H100, H200 and MI300X GPU Droplet prices about 30%
results.author: Saurabh Khatri
highlights:
# DigitalOcean raises H100, H200 and MI300X GPU Droplet prices about 30%

From August 1, 2026, an H100 GPU Droplet costs $4.41 per GPU-hour on demand instead of $3.39. The L40S and RTX Ada Droplets kept their prices.

By Saurabh Khatri · Published Oct 18, 2026

DigitalOcean raised the on-demand prices of its NVIDIA and AMD GPU Droplets on August 1, 2026. It announced the change in a blog post on July 21, 2026, and gave strong demand for advanced GPU capacity as the reason. The H100, H200 and AMD MI300X Droplets each went up about 30%.

## Old and new prices

On-demand price per GPU per hour. Each of these Droplets comes with 1 or 8 GPUs (the L40S and RTX Ada Droplets with 1).

| GPU | Until July 31 | From August 1 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NVIDIA HGX H200 | $3.44 | $4.47 |
| NVIDIA HGX H100 | $3.39 | $4.41 |
| AMD Instinct MI300X | $1.99 | $2.59 |
| NVIDIA L40S | $1.57 | $1.57 |
| NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada | $1.57 | $1.57 |
| NVIDIA RTX 4000 Ada | $0.76 | $0.76 |

The old prices are from DigitalOcean’s pricing page as it stood on July 22, 2026, when it said “New on-demand pricing is coming on August 1, 2026.” The page now also lists the AMD Instinct MI325X on demand at $3.80 per GPU-hour.

## Reserved prices

The blog post says 12-month reserved rates changed on August 1 too. If you signed a contract that locks your rate, it stays until the term ends; a renewal moves to the new reserved rate. The page now lists these 12-month reserved prices per GPU-hour: B300 $7.94, H200 $3.40, H100 $3.26, MI350X $4.76, MI325X $2.88 and MI300X $1.91.

## Who pays more

Every GPU Droplet running on or after August 1 is billed at the new rate. The higher charges first appeared on the bill dated September 1, 2026. DigitalOcean told customers who didn’t want the new rate to destroy their GPU Droplets by August 1. Powering a GPU Droplet off doesn’t stop the charges: the FAQ says you pay until you destroy it.

## What to do

If you run an H100 Droplet around the clock, it now costs about $3,220 a month at $4.41 an hour, against about $2,380 at a 12-month reserved rate of $3.26. Compare both with what other GPU clouds charge before you commit for a year.

results.author: ComputeTape Editorial
highlights:
A canonical-data July 2026 report on current H100 cloud pricing, CT-H100 constituents, freshness, and sample-composition limits.

This July report is generated from the same canonical approved-provider rows used by the CT-H100 page, downloads, embed, homepage, Provider Directory, and H100 comparisons. Data is current through Jul 31, 2026; it is a market indicator, not a quote.

$5.22 / H100-hr CT-H100 median

6 current providers, as of Jul 31, 2026

+21.74% Change from June 30

Published median comparison against $4.29 with sample size 7

On demand Eligible mode

One current, reviewed public H100 price is selected deterministically per provider

## Restated Aug 7, 2026

Restated from $6.5175 across 4 providers to $5.2225 across 6.

- Crusoe and Lambda were excluded on 2026-07-29 because a single 30-day editorial-review clock had lapsed, even though the collector was re-reading and confirming both prices every morning and neither price moved during July. Review expiry sheds cheap long-tail neoclouds faster than vendor-fed hyperscalers, so the four-provider sample was biased upward.
- All six constituents were re-verified live on 2026-08-07 and every price reconciled unchanged. The eligibility gate now runs separate clocks for automated price checks and editorial review.
- The superseded figures were $6.52 across 4 providers, published as a 51.92% change from June 30.

## July H100 pricing read

The canonical July snapshot produces a $5.22 median from 6 providers. The published median is +21.74% versus the final June history point.

- Median of one deterministically selected, current, reviewed public on-demand H100 price per provider. Quote-only, unavailable, unapproved, superseded, and expired rows are excluded.
- The headline change combines price observations and sample composition. It should not be read as a pure same-provider market move.
- The historical series did not preserve row-level constituent IDs for the prior report, so a constant-provider comparison cannot be supported without inventing the prior provider set.

results.author: TechNews 編輯台
highlights:
# AI 算力需求強勁，輝達 A100 至 B200 租賃價格全面走高

作者 TechNews 編輯台 | 發布日期 2026 年 08 月 04 日 10:50 | 分類 AI 人工智慧 , GPU , Nvidia 

AI 基礎設施持續擴張，NVIDIA 多款 GPU 的租賃價格近期不但沒有因新供應增加而下滑，反而多個世代同步上揚。最新市場資料顯示，H100、H200 與 B200 的每小時租金都較先前走高，連較舊的 A100 也維持上行，顯示市場對 AI 算力的需求仍然強勁。

根據 Silicon Data 與多份雲端 GPU 價格追蹤資料，H100 在 2026 年 1 月時每小時租金還略低於 2 美元，如今已升至 2 美元以上，並接近 3 美元；H200 則從年初的較低水準攀升至約 5.50 至 5.80 美元區間。B200 的租金也從 1 月時略低於 5 美元，推升至約 5.50 至 5.80 美元。另有市場快照顯示，H100 SXM 的中位數按需價格約為 3.47 美元，H200 SXM 約為 4.56 美元，A100 80GB PCIe 則約為 1.44 美元，反映不同世代 GPU 仍各自維持一定租賃價值。

## Track 2 under A1-R1.

Issue 007 is a priced-only observation under the two-track cadence adopted August 10 and approved August 11, 2026. The twelve providers excluded at Issue 006 were not recaptured in this Track 2 cycle. Their dispositions carry from the full twenty-seven-provider sweep sealed July 21, and their next full re-verification is due on or about August 21.

The scheduled slots of July 27 and August 3 were not observed. Under A1-R1 the skipped slots force no full sweep and are disclosed here. Movement in Issue 007 is stated against Issue 006.

## What changed around the numbers.

GCP. The rate of record now derives from the published accelerator-optimized pricing page rather than the pricing calculator, a source-class upgrade under the locked hierarchy. The posted $88.490000119 per instance-hour derives to the same $11.0613 rate.

Jarvislabs. An editorial note open since Issue 006 is closed. The hero summary uses starting-at language, but the controlling on-demand GPU table posts a fixed $2.69 per GPU-hour rate.

Atlas Cloud. The $2.95 H100 SXM rate was re-evidenced from a fully logged-out public surface, replacing the conditional evidence state carried at Issue 006.

Paperspace. The promotional-wording watch remains open. The controlling official documentation posts $5.95 per hour with no qualifier, and the same page prices an H100 x8 machine at $47.60, exactly eight times the per-GPU figure.

Precision. CoreWeave's eight-GPU HGX H100 instance at $49.24 per hour derives to $6.155 per GPU-hour, not $6.16. The $6.16 figure on the page belongs to a separate single-GPU inference product.

## The current rule.

The SVCI observes public, fixed, on-demand rates for the H100 SXM 80GB-class anchor across a twenty-seven-provider universe in three tiers, from logged-out surfaces only. Quote-gated, from-floor, spot, committed and account-gated figures never enter a median. Full-machine prices divide to per-GPU in recorded arithmetic. Providers without a comparable public rate are excluded and disclosed, not estimated. Under A1-R1, priced-provider observations are captured fresh on weekly or biweekly issue cycles, while the full twenty-seven-provider panel is re-verified on a monthly clock.

results.title: 【SMM算力午评】H100西部低价微降，国产集群入列扰动存量英伟达 __上海有色网
results.author: 曹正 访问TA的主页 暂无简介 105 篇
highlights:
来源：SMM 2026-07-30 11:42

### H100西部最低月租微降至72000元（降1.37%），国产曙光8000集群入列扰动存量英伟达到期资源，但最高价79000元未动，高位格局不改。偶发低价属捡漏窗口，非趋势反转。算力租赁市场信息靠熟人网络传递，缺乏高效统一平台，行业呼唤透明化信息生态。

【市场概述】 今日上午H100西部区域最低价出现小幅松动。 SMM-H100-80G-整机-西部-包月最低月租从73000元降至72000元，折合最低卡时12.50元。但此为局部存量资源到期释放所致，最高价仍锚定79000元未动，高端算力整体高位运行格局未改。

【H100西部：存量释放微降，高位格局未破】 SMM-H100-80G-整机-西部-包月最低月租从73000元降至72000元，下降1000元，降幅仅1.37%；最低卡时从12.67元降至12.50元，下降0.17元，降幅1.34%。此轮微降的动因在于：国产十万卡级集群"曙光8000"近期投入使用，部分西部运营商机房中托管到期的英伟达存量资源被释放，短期供给脉冲对低价端形成微弱冲击。然而最高价79000元纹丝不动，说明冲击仅限个别到期资源，高端算力价格中枢未见动摇。对于敏锐的需求方，这类偶发性低价资源恰是不可多得的捡漏窗口。
